name: Koushuu no Menzen de Hazukashimerareru Uesugi Keiko Mesubuta Benjo ni Otosareta Hitozuma Shainryou Hen

Because of her husband's failure in the company, a beautiful wife Keiko Uesugi 
is bullied by other wives in the company's dormitory where she lives in. 
As the humiliation goes on, she gradually corrupts into a miserable cumdump...
